title: Project package config scaffold
objective: Measure whether the config-scaffold craftbook scopes runtime/tooling choices and writes a coherent package.json.
prompt: In the `Config Scaffold Eval` project, write `package.json` for a TypeScript Vite widget library called `harbor-widget-kit`. Include module type, exports, files, engines, scripts for dev/build/test/lint/typecheck, dependencies for @vitejs/plugin-react or vite/react as appropriate, devDependencies for TypeScript, Vitest, ESLint, and Prettier, and a packageManager field. Keep it valid JSON.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for config-scaffold. The deliverable is workspace/package.json.
